projects.name: WifiWala (TezNet)
projects.pitch: A multi-tenant ISP management and billing platform.
projects.problem: ISPs require robust, role-based platforms to manage subscriber authentication, subdealers, and billing cycles securely.
projects.what_i_built: A production SaaS platform with Superadmin, ISP Admin, Subdealer, and Subscriber portals, featuring automated background synchronization.
projects.architecture: Django backend with a PostgreSQL database, integrating FreeRADIUS and MikroTik RouterOS API. It utilizes Redis and Celery for background jobs and is deployed via Docker on AWS Lightsail.
projects.measurable_outcome: WifiWala has 1 paying ISP client and ~100 users.

projects.name: Student Headcount Computer Vision Pipeline (PMIU)
projects.pitch: Automated student attendance tracking pipeline deployed across government schools.
projects.problem: Manual daily student headcounts across hundreds of schools are inefficient and prone to reporting errors.
projects.measurable_outcome: Processed daily headcount images across 200+ government schools.

projects.name: Vision-Based Autonomous Car (FYP)
projects.pitch: An edge-computed 1:16 scale robotic vehicle with indoor positioning and lane tracking.
projects.problem: Bringing low-latency autonomous navigation and computer vision capabilities to hardware without cloud dependency.
projects.what_i_built: A hardware-integrated FastAPI backend handling overhead camera coordinates, manual/autonomous switching, and telemetry.
projects.architecture: FastAPI backend running on a Raspberry Pi 5 orchestrating pigpio hardware PWM and WebSockets. The vision pipeline utilizes YOLOv8 NCNN models, OpenCV line tracking, and an ArUco QR code system.

projects.name: The Judge
projects.pitch: An automated, containerized code evaluation platform.
projects.problem: Safely and concurrently executing untrusted user code while providing real-time evaluation metrics.
projects.what_i_built: A Django REST API handling multi-language code submissions, isolated execution, and structured result reporting.
projects.architecture: Django REST backend connected to a normalized PostgreSQL schema. It utilizes a Docker-containerized execution engine to run code safely and sends real-time analytics to a JavaScript frontend.

projects.name: GallaMandi (Wahab Traders / Khatta / Pesticide POS)
projects.pitch: A full-stack agricultural CRM, ledger, and POS system for commission agents.
projects.problem: Agricultural commission agents (Arhtis) lack digitized systems for managing complex ledgers (Khata), crop purchases, and fertilizer inventory.
projects.what_i_built: A full-stack web and mobile application to manage daily ledgers, purchases, and integrated pesticide POS tracking.
projects.architecture: React frontend backed by a Django API and PostgreSQL database, fully containerized via Docker.

projects.name: AirNet WhatsApp Chatbot
projects.pitch: An LLM-powered WhatsApp bot for ISP CRM automation.
projects.problem: ISPs spend too much time handling routine subscriber queries and manually extracting details from rigid admin panels.
projects.what_i_built: A scraper for the AirNet Broadband panel integrated with a WhatsApp chatbot featuring conversational memory.
projects.architecture: A Python web scraper extracts subscriber details and feeds them to an LLM-backed logic engine, routing automated responses through the WhatsApp API.

projects.name: WhatsApp Interview Bot
projects.pitch: A personal technical interview assistant accessible directly via WhatsApp.
projects.problem: Practicing technical questions needs to be frictionless and integrated into daily communication habits.
projects.what_i_built: A conversational bot designed to generate technical MCQs and simulate interview questions for personal study.
projects.architecture: Python backend utilizing the WhatsApp API to dynamically generate, send, and evaluate technical queries.

projects.name: IDM Clone
projects.problem: Learning the complexities of concurrent multi-threading and chunked file downloading.
projects.what_i_built: A desktop-based application structure focused on file chunking, network requests, and managing download queues.
projects.architecture: Python application structured to handle concurrent network I/O operations and file system management.
